XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Start&Stop system - System reset after battery disconnection

XCAPITOLO.Corpo: The battery is located in the engine compartment, on the driver's side, near the wheel arch.

XCAPITOLO.Capitolo: Procedure for disconnecting the battery - Versions with false negative terminal
XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
If it is necessary to disconnect the battery, proceed by disconnecting device (1)

Do not disconnect the battery monitoring sensor (2). The sensor should only be disconnected when replacing the battery.

When reconnecting the battery, turn the ignition key to the "STOP" position with the driver's door closed, and wait at least 1 minute for the system to complete initialisation

XCAPITOLO.Capitolo: Procedure for disconnecting the battery - Versions without false negative terminal
XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
If it is necessary to disconnect the battery, press the button on the connector (B) to detach the connector.

Do not disconnect the battery monitoring sensor (A). The sensor should only be disconnected when replacing the battery.

When reconnecting the battery, turn the ignition key to the "STOP" position with the driver's door closed, and wait at least 1 minute for the system to complete initialisation

To reconnect the battery, proceed as follows:

  • First connect the positive terminal and then the negative terminal of the battery
  • Reset the radio code (if necessary)
  • Clear any errors in the memory
  • Turn the key to the "STOP" position and wait 1 minute (keep doors and windows closed)
  • Switch on the ignition
  • Switch off the ignition

Electric roof initialisation procedure:

  • Turn on the ignition
  • Press and hold the roof closure button
  • Wait for the electric roof to close completely
  • After the roof is completely closed, wait for the electric motor to stop
  • Release the electric roof close button

    The system is now initialised.

After disconnecting the battery, "Radio Code" may appear on the car radio monitor, followed by " - - - -"
You must then enter the radio code.
Use the preset radio station buttons (1 to 6).
If the 4 digits are not entered within 20 seconds, the message "Enter Code - - - -" will appear on the display.
After entering the 4 digits, it may take up to 20 seconds before the car radio starts working.
